Indico Developments · Request for quotation · Package 29

Restaurant kitchen, cold rooms and bar

Katembe Ocean Views, Katembe, Maputo, Mozambique. A building with 12 T3, 3 T2 and 2 compact T2 apartments, a restaurant on floor 4, a supermarket, parking, a club house and a pool.

The plans below show where every item goes, with sizes from the architect's model. The table at the end lists each item, its specification and the quantity to price.
